beats.prompt: Photorealistic live-action cinematic footage. A bald man in a dark navy cloak with a bright blue sash stands in heavy rain on a green hillside, a colossal red dragon coiling through storm clouds behind him. He holds the camera with a hard level stare, chest barely rising. Rain streaks steadily past, water beads on his scalp and shoulders, the cloak hem and blue sash whip and ripple in the wind. Behind him the red dragon slowly coils and lowers its horned head, its neck flexing. Slow steady push-in toward his face. His expression stays fixed and cold. Photoreal rain, wet skin, film grain, shallow depth of field.

Photorealistic live-action cinematic footage. A bald man in a dark navy robe with a blue sash stands in rain, both arms raised, palms pressed together above his head, a blazing ring of white light and branching lightning arcing across the storm sky. He holds the pose, eyes locked on camera. The lightning keeps cracking and forking outward, the white ring pulses and flares, rain streaks down, his sleeves and sash shiver in the wind. Behind him the red dragon's coils shift low in the wet grass. Camera slowly pushes in. His face stays fixed and severe.

Photorealistic live-action cinematic footage. A bald man in a dark navy cloak stands crouched on wet rock in heavy rain, right arm thrust forward pointing straight at camera, jaw set. Around and below him the horned heads of a red dragon rear up through smoke and embers, jaws open, teeth bared. He holds the point. The dragon heads lunge and snap at the air, smoke boils, orange embers swirl upward, rain hammers down and his cloak billows. Camera pushes in steadily on his face. His expression stays fixed and defiant. Photoreal scale detail, wet skin, film grain.

Photorealistic live-action cinematic footage. A bald man in a dark green-grey robe drives a long glowing white blade in a sweeping strike, his cloak flaring, standing in churning turquoise sea water as huge red dragon heads rear around him in a ring. He follows through the swing, twisting at the waist. The blade leaves a bright arc of light, sea spray explodes into the air, water churns and foams, the dragon heads recoil and dive. Camera tracks laterally with the swing. His face stays fixed and fierce. Photoreal water, motion blur, film grain.

Photorealistic live-action cinematic footage. A bald man in a blue kimono with a bright blue sash and a woman with long red-and-black hair in a cream kimono stand face to face holding hands at a red torii gate, cherry blossom petals falling, blurred wedding guests clapping behind them. Both smile gently at each other. Petals drift steadily down through the frame, her red hair lifts slightly in the breeze, fabric stirs, the soft background crowd shifts. Camera drifts in very slowly. Both faces stay fixed, calm and unaltered. Photoreal, warm sunlight, shallow depth of field.

Photorealistic live-action cinematic footage. A woman with long red-and-black hair in a white kimono stands with hands pressed together in prayer, eyes closed, serene. Behind her stands a bald man in an ornate dark blue and gold collared robe and horned crown, holding a tall silver staff topped with a glowing blue gem, a pale blue rune circle burning on his chest, a dragon silhouette on a far peak at sunset. A very slow push-in. The staff glow pulses and brightens, the rune circle flares, her red hair lifts and settles, cloud shadows drift across the hills. Both faces stay fixed and composed. Photoreal, golden hour, film grain.
